title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company (1) under the provisons of GL. c 164, sec 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billied months of February, March and April, 1986. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred rrerasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company's and, for approval by the Departmen of rates to be paid Qualifying Facilities in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utilities Policies Act of 1978.
